note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Servers are started hidden by prepare (helper C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1) and their logs are shown with Get-Content/Select-String. Entra app registration + Azure deployment are done in prepare (unrecorded); the Entra screen then shows the result in the admin center. Sam's sign-in uses a separate Azure CLI profile (AZURE_CONFIG_DIR) so labadmin stays signed in for teardown. GUIDs in the token screens (aud, iss, oid) and the host name must be masked in post.
prepare: dotnet user-jwts create --project src\ExpenseClaims.Api -o token | Out-Null
& $env:MG_SVC start -Name ep02-api -Project (Resolve-Path 'src\ExpenseClaims.Api').Path -Urls http://localhost:5252 -Port 5252
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login -o none }  # owner signs in (lab subscription, labadmin)

$bf = 'C:\lab\mgnet\ep02-body.json'; $appId = az ad app list --display-name contoso-expense-claims-api --query "[0].appId" -o tsv; if (-not $appId) { $appId = az ad app create --display-name contoso-expense-claims-api --sign-in-audience AzureADMyOrg --query appId -o tsv; $created = $true }; $objId = az ad app show --id $appId --query id -o tsv

if ($created) { $scopeId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString(); $roleId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString(); @{ identifierUris = @("api://$appId"); api = @{ oauth2PermissionScopes = @(@{ id = $scopeId; value = 'Claims.Submit'; type = 'User'; isEnabled = $true; adminConsentDisplayName = 'Submit and read expense claims'; adminConsentDescription = 'Submit and read your own expense claims'; userConsentDisplayName = 'Submit and read your expense claims'; userConsentDescription = 'Submit and read your own expense claims' }) }; appRoles = @(@{ id = $roleId; value = 'Claims.Approve'; displayName = 'Claims approver'; description = 'Approve expense claims'; allowedMemberTypes = @('User'); isEnabled = $true }) } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content $bf; az rest --method PATCH --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications/$objId" --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "@$bf" }

if ($created) { $scopeId = az ad app show --id $appId --query "api.oauth2PermissionScopes[0].id" -o tsv; $azcli = ('04b07795', '8ddb', '461a', 'bbee', '02f9e1bf7b46') -join '-'; @{ api = @{ preAuthorizedApplications = @(@{ appId = $azcli; delegatedPermissionIds = @($scopeId) }) } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content $bf; az rest --method PATCH --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/applications/$objId" --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "@$bf" }  # Azure CLI public client id, authorized client application

$spId = az ad sp list --filter "appId eq '$appId'" --query "[0].id" -o tsv; if (-not $spId) { az ad sp create --id $appId -o none; $spId = az ad sp list --filter "appId eq '$appId'" --query "[0].id" -o tsv }

$samId = az ad user list --filter "startswith(displayName,'Sam Demo')" --query "[0].id" -o tsv; $roleId = az ad app show --id $appId --query "appRoles[0].id" -o tsv; $have = az rest --method GET --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals/$spId/appRoleAssignedTo" --query "length(value[?principalId=='$samId'])" -o tsv; if ($have -eq '0') { @{ principalId = $samId; resourceId = $spId; appRoleId = $roleId } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content $bf; az rest --method POST --uri "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/servicePrincipals/$spId/appRoleAssignedTo" --headers 'Content-Type=application/json' --body "@$bf" -o none }
@{ appId = $appId; objId = $objId; spId = $spId; tenantId = (az account show --query tenantId -o tsv) } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02.json')

$shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"

$env:RG = 'rg-mglab-net-02'; $af = 'C:\lab\mgnet\ep02-app.txt'; if (-not (Test-Path $af)) { "contoso-claims-$(Get-Random -Minimum 1000 -Maximum 9999)" | Set-Content $af }; $env:APP = (Get-Content $af).Trim()
$j = Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; $env:TENANT_ID = $j.tenantId; $env:API_CLIENT_ID = $j.appId
bash ./deploy/deploy-appservice.sh
az webapp show -g rg-mglab-net-02 -n $env:APP --query defaultHostName -o tsv | Set-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02-host.txt')

screens.name: local-demo

screens.name: entra-app
steps: Identity > Applications > App registrations > All applications; open 'contoso-expense-claims-api'
Manage > App roles: show Claims.Approve ('Claims approver'), allowed member types Users/Groups, enabled
Manage > Expose an API: show the scope Claims.Submit and, under Authorized client applications, the Azure CLI entry
Identity > Applications > Enterprise applications > 'contoso-expense-claims-api' > Users and groups: show Sam Demo with the role Claims approver
mask: tenant name in the top bar and directory switcher
signed-in account (labadmin) in the account menu

screens.name: entra-token
prepare: $shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"
$j = Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; $env:API_CLIENT_ID = $j.appId; $env:API_HOST = (Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02-host.txt')).Trim()

$env:AZURE_CONFIG_DIR = 'C:\lab\mgnet\az-sam'; az account get-access-token --scope "api://$env:API_CLIENT_ID/Claims.Submit" --query expiresOn -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --allow-no-subscriptions -o none }  # owner signs in as sam.demo (separate Azure CLI profile, labadmin stays signed in)

prepare: $shim = 'C:\lab\mgnet\bin'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $shim | Out-Null; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $shim 'zip'))) { [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $shim 'zip'), "#!/bin/bash`n# zip shim (Git Bash has no zip): called as: zip -qr <out.zip> .`n/c/Windows/System32/tar.exe -a -cf `"`$2`" .`n") }; if (-not (Get-Command jq -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { winget install --id jqlang.jq -e --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements | Out-Null }; $env:PATH = "C:\Program Files\Git\bin;$shim;$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\WinGet\Links;$env:PATH"
$j = Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02.json') | ConvertFrom-Json; $env:API_CLIENT_ID = $j.appId; $env:API_HOST = (Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02-host.txt')).Trim()

$env:AZURE_CONFIG_DIR = 'C:\lab\mgnet\az-sam'; az account get-access-token --scope "api://$env:API_CLIENT_ID/Claims.Submit" --query expiresOn -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --allow-no-subscriptions -o none }  # owner signs in as sam.demo (separate Azure CLI profile, labadmin stays signed in)

$tok = az account get-access-token --scope "api://$env:API_CLIENT_ID/Claims.Submit" --query accessToken -o tsv; $c = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post "https://$env:API_HOST/api/claims" -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $tok" } -ContentType 'application/json' -Body (@{ description = 'Train to Lisbon'; amount = 32.5; currency = 'EUR'; category = 'Travel'; incurredOn = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-dd') } | ConvertTo-Json); $env:CLAIM_ID = $c.id

teardown: $j = Get-Content ('C:\lab\mgnet\ep02.json') -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($j) { az ad sp delete --id $j.spId 2>$null; az ad app delete --id $j.appId 2>$null }
prepare_local: Use-DotNetSdk -Channel 10.0   # kit helper: uses the installed .NET 10 SDK, else installs it into C:\MGLab\dotnet (no admin)
if (Test-Path 'C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1') { & 'C:\lab\mgnet\svc.ps1' stop -Name ep02-api }   # an API left from an earlier take keeps its data and locks bin: the screen prepare starts a fresh one
dotnet build src\ExpenseClaims.Api -v q --nologo; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'dotnet build failed' }
